title: Benefits of living in the city
sentences: This is a follow-up to the benefits of living in the countryside.
Now I'm going to talk about the benefits of living in the city.
And there are many benefits to living in the city.
But of course this depends on where in the world you live,
and which cities you live in.
There are many differences, big differences between different cities.
For example, when it comes to the size of cities,
it's completely different to live in Haugesund in Norway,
which has roughly thirty, forty, up to fifty thousand inhabitants,
compared to Oslo, which has six hundred, seven hundred thousand inhabitants.
